title: Excellent experience
text: We did the adventure hunt in Granada— such a fun and engaging experience! We live in Granada but it’s also fun even for locals. The kids loved solving the clues along the way, and they learned some cool facts about our beautiful city too. A great mix of nature and learning!
author: aliciafK4861MZ

title: A new way to explore a new city
text: Me and a small group of friends tried Adventure hunt together, recommended by a friend lives in the city. It was fun, a bit different to our expectations but we actually really enjoyed it. Exactly the hidden secrets of this old city are so interesting because I really like historical stories. Even though it was really hot in Granada at this season, but the end of the route bring us to a very peaceful hidden area which is perfect for a picnic and the girls enjoyed the pictures taking too. We love it, may try it again in some other locations
author: Wander39528466801

title: Amazing!
text: I live in Granada and I thought I knew her well, but doing Adventure Hunt with my wife was a total surprise. It’s like an outdoor escape room, with stories, riddles and city tours. The ghosts and legends part was our favorite. You can tell that the creators know a lot about local history. Highly recommended!
author: marianoz303
